survey.absoluteAccuracy: Source-reported below 2 cm RTK RMSE; not independently verified here; shared base/trajectory error correlations unquantified.
survey.method: Source declares two Leica GS18 RTK GNSS instruments: static rebar base, one-second collection interval, more than three-hour sessions, rover surveyed PIDs/NVAs/VVAs, OPUS base solution and Leica Infinity adjustment.
survey.reportAcquisitionDate: Report filenames use 20250722; narrative names July 20th 2025 for Cape May collection. These conflicting source dates remain distinct; report generation time is not a survey epoch.

roles.nva: Source describes surveyed hard flat surfaces for vertical comparison to ground-classified lidar; report Type=nva, 166 rows, 164 enabled/2 Turned Off, 0 horizontal/164 vertical measured, literal #CPs Withheld: 166 of 166.
roles.pid: Source describes surveyed checkerboard centers and image-selected horizontal comparison; report Type=pid, 17 rows, all enabled, 17 horizontal/vertical measured, literal #CPs Withheld: 0 of 17.
roles.fittedControls: No unambiguous per-point fitting membership or adjustment-input history established by the retained deposit. PID 0-of-17 withholding alone does not prove points were fitted.

roles.untouchedCheckpoints: Source reports NVA 166-of-166 withholding; preserve as source text with QA-only statement. No new split, held-out evaluation or independent correctness qualification performed.
